mapper.select: select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(case when item_type = 'MOVIE' then 1 else 0 end) as movie, sum(case when item_type = 'TV' then 1 else 0 end) as tv, sum(case when item_type = 'BOOK' then 1 else 0 end) as book, sum(case when item_type = 'PLACE' then 1 else 0 end) as place, count(*) as total from sgj_item where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 5 month) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by month

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as cnt from sgj_note where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 5 month) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by month
select count(*) from sgj_note where del_flag = '0' and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m')

select item_id as itemId, item_type as itemType, title, status, rating, tags, cover_url as coverUrl, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from sgj_item where del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, item_id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) from sgj_item where del_flag = '0' and status = 'DONE'
and create_by = #{createBy}
